Role Summary Join Coca-Cola's Global Equipment Platforms team and help shape the future of iconic products-like Freestyle fountain dispensers, coolers, vending machines, and our digital apps. This is your opportunity to combine modern UI design skills with systems thinking for experiences that touch millions worldwide.

We're a highly collaborative, innovative, in-office team passionate about growth, consumer insights, and blazing new trails in digital equipment.

Key Responsibilities Design pixel-perfect user interfaces for equipment displays (Freestyle, vending machines, coolers), embedded screens, web applications, and mobile apps (iOS & Android) Deliver high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes using Figma, clearly communicating user flows, states, and interactions, while aligning every detail with established UI guidelines and specifications.

Use component libraries, variants, and responsive design principles to ensure scalable, consistent solutions across platforms Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams-including software engineers, digital product leads, and fellow designers-by participating in in-office collaboration, design jams, and hands-on field visits for direct observations and interviews.

Support UX research by participating in user observations, interviews, and feedback sessions-translating insights into actionable UI improvements. Document UI specifications, standards, and design system components for seamless development handoff.

Contribute to, refine, and champion our UI Design System and global brand standards, ensuring consistency, scalability, and outstanding visual quality across platforms. Confidently present, explain, and defend your design decisions to peers, leadership, and partners-while actively seeking and embracing constructive feedback.

Key Deliverables Pixel-perfect, production-ready UI designs and interactive prototypes in Figma. Clear, detailed UI specifications, component documentation, and design system updates. Actionable insights and recommendations informed by user fieldwork and observation. Compelling design presentations and storytelling to stakeholders and collaborators.

Required Skills & Competencies Bachelor's degree in interaction design, HCI, visual communication, graphic/industrial design, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of hands-on design experience for digital products (embedded/IoT devices a strong plus).

Expert-level proficiency in Figma (including component shared libraries, variants, interactive prototyping, responsive workflows, design systems) for designing high-fidelity UIs and interactive prototypes.

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) Prototyping, wireframing, visual design, sketching, ideation, color theory, typography, and documentation. Proven ability to deliver and iterate on highly polished interfaces.

Effective communicator who confidently presents and defends design decisions, accepting and integrating feedback. Effective collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, especially in face-to-face and workshop environments. Driven by empathy for the user and a relentless focus on creating delightful, impactful experiences.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, collaborative environment Preferred Skills & Competencies Familiarity with front-end technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS) to facilitate effective collaboration with developers. Experience designing for embedded systems, IoT devices, or equipment interfaces.

Experience working with agile development processes and rapid iteration cycles. Knowledge of accessibility standards and best practices. Leadership & Culture Fit Collaborative mindset-thrives in team settings where sharing, supporting, and learning from each other is the norm.

Growth-minded, creative, and always curious-driven to learn, improve, and innovate Consumer-obsessed- relentlessly focused on what delights, inspires, and improves user experience Flexible, proactive, and energized by hands-on, in-office teamwork and direct user engagement.

Fun, bold, and passionate about digital transformation and cutting-edge technology. You will be required to share a portfolio showcasing impactful work on embedded, mobile, and/or web platforms. In addition, you will be required to demonstrate Figma capabilities through sharing files or demonstrating skills.

Make your mark in a global team where innovation is the standard, and your curiosity will always be rewarded. Ready to shape the future of digital experiences? Apply now!

Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

About Skio Skio helps Shopify brands turn one-time buyers into subscribers (and keep them). We ship new features every week because standing still means falling behind. We're competing against platforms that haven't changed in years, and we're winning.

Ask our competitors where most of their customers come to when they grow out their platform (and we don’t expect this to change). That's why brands like Grüns, Everyday Dose, IM8, and Instant Hydration trust us with their subscription revenue.

If you want to work somewhere that moves at startup speed but serves real enterprise brands, you're in the right place. We are looking for a talented Product Designer to help us create impactful, user-centric designs that drive the success of our product.

If you are passionate about solving complex problems and thrive in a collaborative, dynamic startup environment, we'd love to meet you. Role Overview As a Product Designer at Skio , you will be responsible for leading the design process from conception to execution.

You will work closely with a product manager, engineers, and other stakeholders to create intuitive and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of user experience (UX) principles, user interface (UI) design, interaction design, and experience designing for complex B2B platforms.

Key Responsibilities Wire-framing & Prototyping: Create wireframes, prototypes, and detailed design mockups that effectively communicate design ideas and solutions.
Design Systems: Support and maintain a design system that ensures consistency across the product suite.
Documentation: Prepare and present design solutions, and provide clear specifications for engineering teams.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on design goals and requirements.
Qualifications 3+ years of experience in product design, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
Strong portfolio demonstrating UX/UI design skills, including wireframes, prototypes, and beautiful solutions.
Is an expert with using Figma
Self-motivated and is willing to adjust quickly to new requirements/priorities in a fast paced environment.
Experience communicating design decisions and working effectively with engineering teams

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Product Designer - Interactive Learning and Games to support the design and development of interactive learning experiences within our DreamBox portfolio. This role contributes to creating visually compelling, engaging, and accessible educational products used by students at scale.

You work closely with product managers, engineers, curriculum experts, and researchers to bring ideas to life, test concepts with users, and continuously improve experiences through iteration. This role is highly collaborative and hands-on, with a focus on delivering high-quality craft within defined product areas.

In This Role You Will Design Execution & Craft Design interactive learning experiences and game-based features from concept through implementation Create visually compelling designs, animations, and interaction patterns that bring digital experiences to life Apply strong visual design craft, attention to detail, and consistency across all deliverables Balance engaging gameplay with meaningful learning outcomes aligned to product goals Collaboration & Delivery Partner closely with engineers to deliver polished, high-quality, production-ready experiences Collaborate with product managers, curriculum experts, and researchers to align design solutions with user and learning needs Clearly communicate design decisions and articulate rationale through storytelling and presentations User-Centered Design & Iteration Develop prototypes to explore ideas, validate concepts, and accelerate decision-making Incorporate feedback from students, educators, and stakeholders to refine and improve designs Apply user-centered design principles, accessibility standards, and inclusive design practices across all work Tools & Innovation Utilize modern design and prototyping tools, including AI-assisted workflows, to rapidly iterate and improve efficiency Explore emerging tools and technologies to enhance design quality and creative problem-solving Core Competencies for Success Drives Results – Delivers high-quality design work that meets user needs and supports product goals Collaborates – Builds effective working relationships across cross-functional teams to deliver shared outcomes Customer Focus – Designs with a deep understanding of users, creating engaging experiences for diverse learners Action Oriented – Quickly generates ideas, prototypes solutions, and iterates based on feedback Communicates Effectively – Clearly articulates design decisions and tells compelling stories to stakeholders Credentials and Experience 5+ years of experience in interactive product design, game design, illustration, animation, and/or learning design, supported by a portfolio that demonstrates exceptional visual craft and the ability to conceive, design, animate, prototype, and deliver engaging interactive learning experiences.

Shipped game or educational product experience is strongly preferred.

A portfolio showcasing visually compelling digital products and interactive experiences delivered from concept through implementation Demonstrated ability to design experiences that incorporate animation, motion, gameplay, or rich user interaction Proficiency in creating high-fidelity prototypes, rapidly iterating on designs, and using modern design tools and workflows Strong capability in applying user-centered design principles, accessibility standards, and inclusive design practices Proven track record of collaborating closely with engineers to deliver polished, production-ready solutions Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and curiosity for leveraging emerging technologies to enhance workflows Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to clearly explain design decisions Demonstrated ability to incorporate user feedback, including playtesting insights, into iterative improvements Legal right to work in the United Kingdom This role is designated as remote or hybrid based in Bath, UK.

About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products. This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined.

You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users. What You'll Own Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications. Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services. Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components. Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation. Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback. Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications. Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work. Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design. Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design. Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy. Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences. Portfolio is required.

Design Stack Figma FigJam Design Systems Auto Layout Interactive Prototyping iOS Human Interface Guidelines Material Design The Kind of Builder We Want Thinks mobile-first. Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality. Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do. Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products. Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces. This Role Is Not For Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding. People who design without considering real user behaviour. Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers. Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in South Korea . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in South Korea .

Language English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Portfolio review Practical design task (if applicable) Role-specific interview CEO / Final interview For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving.

Whether it’s porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners’ internal teams.

We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as: 2K Xbox Meta Obsidian Entertainment Turtle Rock Studios Gearbox Software At Devoted Studios , we’re committed to making outsourcing more efficient, collaborative, and impactful.

If you're passionate about co-development, game art, or solving technical challenges on a global scale. We are looking for a Technical UI Designer who lives and breaths in Unreal Engine. This is a hands-on implementation role, building out UI features and animations from design handoff to shipped product, working in Unreal Engine daily.

Responsibilities: Build, implement, and polish UI features and systems using Unreal Engine, UMG, and Blueprints Own UI animation — motion design, transitions, reactive states, and feel — from concept through final implementation Collaborate closely with UX designers, UI artists, and engineers to bring features from spec to shipping Diagnose and resolve UI performance issues; contribute to reducing technical debt in existing systems Create and maintain reusable UI components and documentation that other designers can build on Iterate fast based on feedback from leads and QA — shipping quality on a live-service cadence Requirements Professional experience implementing UI in a shipped game, using Unreal Engine (UMG + Blueprints) or equivalent engine Strong animation sensibility — you understand timing, easing, and motion hierarchy, and you can build it yourself rather than hand it off Experience with visual scripting languages (Blueprints, Lua, or equivalent) Comfortable reading and acting on feedback from leads, UX, and QA without friction Portfolio or reel demonstrating shipped UI work — implementation quality matters more than concept art Nice to have Experience on a live-service title with frequent content updates Familiarity with view models or data-driven UI architecture Experience with 3D packages (Maya, 3ds Max) for asset prep Exposure to performance profiling and GPU/CPU cost awareness for UI Benefits Why Join Us?

We offer: Strong and enthusiastic team – you will have the opportunity for knowledge sharing, learning, and professional self-development Interesting and challenging tasks – solve diverse and challenging issues, communicate with people within the company as well as with our partners; Convenient working conditions – remote work, the opportunity to build your own working day with flexible working hours А chance to work in a highly professional and dynamic team working with a wide range of International Game Production projects, attractive remuneration package, and opportunities to develop professionally.

This is a remote, full-time contracted position. At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

Timely and SalonBiz serve over 30,000 customers in 100 countries and are on a mission to build the leading platform for beauty professionals. Together we make up EverWell, an EverCommerce vertical. Between us, we offer SaaS solutions to customers of varying sizes and stages, serving different customer profiles within the beauty industry.

We’re part of the wider EverCommerce ecosystem and exist to simplify and empower the lives of business owners. We’ve got big goals and we’re ready to achieve them.

This is where you come in!
As a Lead Product Designer at EverWell, you’ll lead UX outcomes for Timely across desktop and mobile, delivering impactful end-to-end product design from discovery through to delivery and optimisation. You’ll champion human-centred design, collaborate cross-functionally, and drive innovative, user-focused experiences across complex product ecosystems.
This role is ideal for a strategic and hands-on design leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments. You’ll influence product direction, mentor fellow designers, improve design practices, and partner with stakeholders to create seamless experiences that deliver value for customers and the business.

Deliver world-class product design for complex products, using insights-driven approaches to solve meaningful user problems.
Drive seamless cross-product experiences by identifying opportunities that benefit multiple user groups.
Lead UX activities across the product lifecycle, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Research teams.
Conduct and apply UX research, define success metrics, and use data to measure design impact.
Foster strong collaboration through clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and sharing insights and work in progress.
Mentor and coach designers and stakeholders while continuously improving design practices and team capability.

10+ years’ experience in SaaS product design, with a strong portfolio of impactful work.
Proven ability to lead end-to-end user-centred design processes, from research and problem definition through to delivery and measurement.
Strong expertise across UX methodologies including research, journey mapping, prototyping, testing, analytics, and ideation.
Experience designing complex, cross-product experiences across responsive web and iOS platforms.
Demonstrated success improving design practices, increasing team maturity, and mentoring designers.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across all levels of the business.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and delivering pragmatic, iterative solutions in fast-paced agile environments.
Growth mindset with a collaborative and humble approach.

We set a high bar and support our team to innovate and focus on continuous growth. You’ll enjoy a professional development budget to fuel your growth, and an annual wellness allowance to fund the things that support your wellbeing.

We're a well-funded (Series A), fast-growing AI procurement intelligence company based in Munich, Germany , building software that helps industrial companies optimize purchasing and supply chain operations. Our product is used daily by non-technical procurement professionals, and AI agents sit at the core of what we do.
We're looking for a Senior or Staff Product Designer to define how agentic AI capabilities surface in our product — making AI feel natural, trustworthy, and genuinely useful for people who aren't data scientists or engineers. You'll join a small, senior design team working closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts in a product that directly impacts real cost savings for customers.
This is an on-site role in Munich . Visa sponsorship is not available.

Define how agentic AI capabilities present in the product — from communicating "the agent is working" through to "here's what it found."
Design interaction patterns where AI and human judgment collaborate rather than compete, with a focus on trust and transparency.
Produce short-horizon vision work (3–6 month outlook) as prototypes and tangible artifacts that guide engineering and product teams.
Raise overall product craft and coherence as engineering velocity and feature output scale.
Work directly in code for last-mile polish — check out PRs and tweak interactions before features ship.
Collaborate across product management, engineering, and procurement domain experts to translate complex workflows into usable experiences.
Define and maintain design systems and component libraries to ensure consistency at scale.
Conduct user research and usability testing with non-technical procurement professionals to continuously sharpen product decisions.

Senior-level product designer with a strong portfolio of shipped product work — ideally in B2B SaaS, complex workflows, or data-heavy products.
Broad ("block-shaped") skill set spanning visual design, interaction design, product thinking, and prototyping in code — not a single-specialty T-shape.
Practical experience prototyping beyond Figma — able to build runnable prototypes that clearly communicate intent and behavior.
Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with related tools (FigJam, Sketch, InVision, or similar).
Experience defining and maintaining design systems and component libraries.
Experience conducting user research and usability testing to inform product decisions.
Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, data science) in a fast-paced environment.
Thoughtful, well-formed opinions about how AI should appear in products — with emphasis on trust, transparency, and appropriate levels of automation.
Regular user of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) as part of your research, ideation, and prototyping workflow.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and inventing new interaction patterns for genuinely novel problems.

Experience designing for non-technical users in complex B2B domains (e.g., procurement, manufacturing, supply chain, ERP-adjacent).
Prior work designing agentic or autonomous AI features in a shipped product.
Background at enterprise software companies (e.g., SAP, Celonis, or similar process-intelligence platforms).
Location
This role is based on-site in Munich, Bavaria, Germany . We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Reporting to the Head of Product Design, you'll operate as a direct peer to PM and Engineering, bringing user evidence, strategic thinking, and a strong point of view to product decisions.

You'll own the second half of product management: translating strategy into requirements, managing project timelines, coordinating with engineering, and driving features from concept to launch. Your work will directly influence activation, retention, and the quality of the AI-assisted creation experience millions of creators depend on.

Own product outcomes end-to-end : Take full ownership from problem framing and research through shipping, measurement, and iteration
Lead design of complex features : Design sophisticated product features with high visual craft and strategic product thinking
Raise the craft bar : Hold a high quality standard in visual and interaction design, elevating it through critique and pairing with peers
Manage the build: Coordinate with engineering, ensure quality throughout development, and own go-to-market readiness
Build reusable patterns : Contribute to Kittl's evolving design process, designing system and emerging AI patterns
What you'll need
Experience : Minimum 6 years designing digital products, with at least 2 years shipping consumer or prosumer products at scale
Portfolio : Strong portfolio showing end-to-end ownership including research, interaction design, visual craft, product thinking, and measurable impact of shipped work
Product ownership readiness: Demonstrated ability or clear readiness to step into product management responsibilities - managing timelines, coordinating stakeholders
AI design experience : Hands-on experience designing for AI-driven or generative product surfaces, with focus on embedding AI for genuine user value
Principled decision-making: Balances user needs, product constraints, and strategic direction to find the best feasible path forward through thoughtful compromise and clear decision-making
Bias for action : High quality bar combined with speed, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to step beyond pure design into product ownership and execution

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa Product Designer Pleno, para atuar em parceria comuma das maiorescompanhias de alimentos e bebidas do Brasil. É imprescindível que a pessoa possua experiência em interfaces conversacionais. Irá atuar nas frentes de atendimento (customer sucess) e na experiência de alguns agentes de IA que estamos construindo para o time comercial. Então precisamos de um designer de produto com Skills fortes e comprovadas em UX Writing RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Mapear e desenhar jornadas: Definir fluxos de navegação, árvores de decisão, scripts e arquitetura de informação específicos para interfaces conversacionais (chatbots, assistentes virtuais, canais de mensageria).
Pesquisa e validação: Conduzir pesquisas com usuários, testes de usabilidade de diálogos e análise de dados para compreender as necessidades, comportamentos e fricções na comunicação.
Prototipação especializada: Criar wireframes, fluxos de conversação e protótipos para validar e ajustar interações com usuários e clientes internos.

happyhotel baut den AI Revenue Manager: eine neue Produktkategorie, die Dashboard-lastige SaaS ablöst und sich für Hoteliers anfühlt wie ein eigener Revenue-Experte auf Abruf – erreichbar über WhatsApp, Telegram und ein fokussiertes Web-UI.

Kein "AI-Feature auf ein bestehendes Produkt geklebt", sondern ein Produkt, das von Grund auf um einen konversationellen Agenten herum gedacht ist. Für diese Mission suchen wir dich als Founding Designer – direkt an der Seite von Marius (Co-founder & CTPO) und Sebastian (Co-founder).
📎 Deine Rolle
Du bist die erste Designerin bzw. der erste Designer in einem frisch formierten Produkt-Team und definierst, wie sich ein AI-Agent im Hotelalltag anfühlen muss, damit ihm ein General Manager sein Pricing anvertraut.

Du beantwortest Fragen, für die es heute schlicht keine Design-Patterns gibt: Wie übergibt ein AI-Agent sauber an einen menschlichen Experten, wenn er unsicher ist? Wie werden AI-Entscheidungen transparent und nachvollziehbar, ohne den Nutzer mit Daten zu erschlagen? Wo hört das Chat-UI auf, wo fängt das Web-UI an?
Du arbeitest noch bevor die erste Zeile Produktivcode geschrieben ist – in Prototypen, mit echten Hoteliers als Beta-Design-Partnern, in täglichem Austausch mit den Foundern.
‍
🤝 Deine Aufgaben
Du definierst das Interaktionsparadigma des Produkts: Wie fühlt sich ein AI Revenue Manager an? Was passiert im Chat, was im Web-UI, was proaktiv, was reaktiv?
Du gestaltest die AI-zu-Mensch-Eskalation – eine der zentralen Produktflächen in unserem hybriden Modell, in dem interne RM-Experten einspringen, wenn die AI nicht sicher genug ist.
Du machst AI-Entscheidungen sichtbar und vertrauenswürdig: jede Empfehlung mit Begründung, jedes Ergebnis nachvollziehbar – das Langzeitgedächtnis des Agenten als erstklassiges Designobjekt.
Du baust schnell testbare Prototypen mit AI-assistierten Tools (Figma Make, v0, Lovable, Cursor, Claude Code) und etablierst sie so, dass auch PM und Engineering eigenständig konsistente Prototypen bauen können – du bist Enabler, nicht Bottleneck.
Du führst gemeinsam mit dem PM einen kontinuierlichen Research-Loop mit ~10 Beta-Design-Partnern und unserem internen RM-Team.
Du entwickelst die visuelle Sprache des neuen Produkts – modern, zugänglich, vertrauenswürdig – konsistent über Chat, Web und Benachrichtigungen. So nah am Code wie möglich.
‍ 💙 Dein Profil
3+ Jahre Product Design in digitalen Produkten, idealerweise SaaS.
Erfahrung im 0-to-1- oder Founding-Kontext – du kannst unter Ambiguität entscheiden und brauchst keinen Detail-Brief.
Echtes Interesse an AI-Produkten – nicht "AI-Buzzword im Lebenslauf", sondern Lust, die UX-Patterns für agentic products mitzuerfinden.
Du prototypst nah am Code und nutzt AI-assistierte Tools aktiv, um Feedback-Loops auf Tage statt Wochen zu verkürzen.
Fundierte User-Research-Praxis: Interviews mit nicht-technischen, zeitknappen Nutzern führen und daraus Entscheidungen ableiten.
Du arbeitest gern in engen Schleifen mit Foundern und Engineering – kurze Nachrichten, schnelle Calls, Entscheidungen am selben Tag, Revert am nächsten, wenn nötig.
Du bist bereit regelmäßig mit dem Team vor Ort in Offenburg zu arbeiten oder remote mit engen Touchpoints.
Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch (beides auf professionellem Niveau).
‍
🚀 Was dich erwartet:‍
Founding-Level-Ownership: Du prägst, wie sich eine neue Produktkategorie anfühlt – nicht nur ein weiteres Feature.
Ein Problem, das sich zu lösen lohnt: Unabhängige Hoteliers bekommen zum ersten Mal die Schlagkraft eines dedizierten Revenue Managers. Echter Business-Impact, echte Menschen auf der anderen Seite.
Direkter Draht zu den Foundern: Du arbeitest täglich mit Marius (CTPO) und Sebastian – kurze Wege, echte Entscheidungen, keine Design-Hierarchie dazwischen.
Technisch wirklich ambitioniertes Produkt: Konversationelle AI in einer datendichten, hochsensiblen Domäne – hier entstehen Patterns, die es so noch nicht gibt.
Echter Zeitdruck mit echten Partnern: Committete Beta-Design-Partner warten auf Prototypen. Bis Ende 2026 nutzen erste Kunden das Live-Produkt.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Arbeit, persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, Hansefit, Bikeleasing, Workation und die üblichen Benefits – aber ehrlich gesagt: wenn du wegen der Benefits kommst, bist du hier falsch.

Asthe Senior Product Designer you will own complex product experiences from discovery through delivery for a new AI-enabled decision-support system. The work today is spread across several disconnected legacy systems, and we are replacing it with a single workspace: a prioritized work queue, a unified view that pulls scattered records together, enrichment panels, and dashboards.
Design sits in the product organization here, reporting through the Product Lead alongside product ownership and quality. You will partner daily with product and engineering to define scope, tradeoffs, and priorities, and you will support engineering through implementation rather than handing off and moving on.
This is a discovery-first role. Before anything is built you will interview and observe the people who do this work, map their current process, and design the future one. That becomes an interactive prototype the customer reviews and approves before production code is written, and it is an early program deliverable, so this work starts immediately. Design artifacts on this program are formally reviewed against written criteria, which means your work carries real weight from the first week.
The core design problem is trust. The system recommends what deserves attention and explains why, and your job is to present that so a user can evaluate it rather than simply accept it: showing the supporting evidence, making uncertainty visible, and making disagreement easy. You will work alongside an existing designer and with product, engineering, and data staff.
This is a hands-on role and a senior one. You are here to do the design work, and you will own how design gets done on this program: the research approach, the patterns, and the standard the work is held to. We are building out our design practice and the person in this seat shapes it. This is a fully remote role with occasional travel (up to 25%) to DEFCON AI HQ, customer sites, and vendor facilities as required.

Discovery and Workflow Design
Run structured discovery with end users: interviews, shadowing sessions, and workflow observation
Produce current-state and future-state workflow maps that hold up to review by the people who do the work
Translate mission and operational needs into interaction designs, and know which constraints are real versus assumed
Deliver a fully interactive clickable prototype covering prioritized queues, enrichment panels, record history, and dashboards, as an early program deliverable
Interface and Interaction Design
Design the user workspace end to end: work queue, unified record view, evidence and enrichment panels, decision flow, record history, trend views, and operational dashboards
Apply and contribute to a design system so the interface stays coherent as scope grows across releases, and so components carry forward to other products rather than being rebuilt
Design for high-volume, repetitive work: keyboard efficiency, scannability, minimal context switching, and low error rates under time pressure
Design accessible interfaces that meet Section 508 and WCAG requirements
Identify gaps in the existing experience and propose improvements rather than waiting to be assigned them
Designing for AI Output
Present model recommendations, confidence, and supporting evidence so users can evaluate them rather than defer to them
Make uncertainty and gaps visible, including the case where the system returns insufficient evidence
Design the review and override path so disagreeing with the system is easy and the reason is captured
Design audit and traceability views so any conclusion can be traced back to its source records
Delivery Partnership
Partner closely with product and engineering from problem definition through launch, not just at handoff
Work directly with front-end engineers and hand off designs they can build from without guessing, and improve that handoff into a dependable pipeline rather than a recurring negotiation
Review builds against the design and hold the quality bar through implementation

We are supportive

Design smart experiences that adapt to user behavior, use context, and anticipate intent. Keep interfaces familiar, welcoming, and clear yet advanced. Make every interaction simple and intuitive.

Storyous je pokladní systém pro gastro podniky, který funguje samostatně v rámci fintech skupiny Teya , k níž jsme se připojili v roce 2021.
Naše portfolio stojí na robustním pokladním systému, pokročilé datové analytice a dalších modulech, které ve spojení s integracemi a vlastním platebním řešením Teya tvoří komplexní all-in-one řešení pro jednotlivé podniky i řetězce s desítkami poboček.
Hledáme Product Designera/ku , který/á bude designovým partnerem pro Product a Engineering a převezme odpovědnost za UX/UI napříč celým produktem. Budeš převádět produktová zadání a vlastní nápady do promyšlených návrhů a prototypů, hledat příležitosti ke zjednodušení uživatelských cest a podílet se na tom, jak bude Storyous fungovat v praxi.
Jedná se o nově vytvořenou roli s velkou mírou autonomie. Máme existující design language a designové podklady ve Figmě , ale současně plánujeme větší redesign tabletové aplikace a chceme náš design dále sjednocovat a rozvíjet.
Co tě v roli čeká
Budeš navrhovat UX/UI napříč tabletovou aplikací, webovým Adminem, mobilní aplikací, Kioskem a Premium Analytics.
Zapojíš se do přípravy a realizace většího redesignu tabletové aplikace.
Budeš převádět produktová zadání, zákaznické potřeby a vlastní návrhy do user flow, wireframů, interaktivních prototypů a finálních návrhů ve Figmě.
Budeš aktivně hledat místa, kde lze produkt nebo uživatelskou cestu zjednodušit a zlepšit.
Vyrazíš do terénu za našimi zákazníky, povedeš user interviews, budeš pozorovat používání produktu v reálném provozu a využiješ zjištění pro další návrhy.
Budeš rozvíjet naše design language, komponenty a šablony a dbát na konzistenci napříč platformami.
Budeš úzce spolupracovat s Productem a Engineeringem od prvního nápadu až po implementaci.
Budeš řešit designová dilemata, připravovat návrhy včetně potřebných stavů a edge cases a dokumentovat designová rozhodnutí ve Figmě, Jira a Confluence.
Budeš využívat AI nástroje, například Claude, pro zrychlení rutinní práce, iteraci návrhů a tvorbu klikacích prototypů.
Koho hledáme
Tahle role je vhodná pro člověka, který už má zkušenost s designem digitálních produktů a chce převzít širší ownership. Nehledáme pouze někoho, kdo umí vytvořit kvalitní obrazovku. Potřebujeme designera, který rozumí problému, umí pracovat s uživatelem, dokáže návrh obhájit a dotáhnout ho ve spolupráci s týmem.

s.h: Hodit se k nám budeš, pokud
Benefit Plus Cafeteria s měsíčním kreditem 2 000 Kč;
s.t:
flexibilitu a možnost občasné práce z domova;
MacBook a další vybavení potřebné k práci;
palivo v podobě čerstvého ovoce, snacků a kvalitní kávy v naší karlínské kanceláři;
nově vytvořenou roli s velkým prostorem pro vlastní iniciativu a rozhodování;
přímý vliv na UX/UI celého produktu a možnost vidět dopad své práce u reálných zákazníků;
plnohodnotný onboarding do produktu a podporu při poznávání domény.
Proč může tahle role dávat smysl právě tobě
Nechceš být pouze vykonavatelem hotových designových zadání, ale chceš ovlivňovat, co a proč se bude v produktu stavět.
Baví tě kombinace samostatné práce, user research, prototypování a spolupráce s engineeringem.
Chceš pracovat na produktu, který lidé používají v reálném a náročném provozu.
Hledáš prostředí, kde můžeš využít dosavadní zkušenosti a zároveň si vybudovat silný ownership nad celou produktovou oblastí.
Vyhovuje ti autonomie, ale zároveň víš, že s ní jde ruku v ruce odpovědnost za kvalitu výsledku.
Jak probíhá výběrové řízení
Pošli nám CV společně s portfoliem. Zajímá nás, na čem jsi pracoval/a.
Proběhne krátký call s HR (online).
Následovat bude interview se Zuzkou, naší Product Managerkou, kde si řeknete více o roli, produktu a způsobu spolupráce (osobně u nás v kanceláři).
Dáme ti krátké praktické case study zadání s rozumným časem na přípravu.
Ve finálním kole case study společně projdete se Zuzkou a designovým expertem z Teya (online).
Zní to jako role pro tebe? Pošli nám CV a portfolio. Rádi se s tebou spojíme, představíme ti detail role i fungování týmu a pobavíme se o tom, jak by mohla vypadat naše spolupráce.

Lead Product Designer
The design philosophy
At Fyxer, design starts with human behaviour rather than with screens, components or flows. We think the best product decisions come from understanding why people do what they do, and working back from there. It isn't a principle we put on a wall. It's how we make decisions.
What you're walking into
We're not starting from zero. We have a creative designer on the team, a visual identity built with Red Antler, a design system, and a product that real users depend on every day.
What we don't have is a senior product design voice. Someone who gets the first call across the company when a product, experience or communication decision needs a human-behaviour lens on it.
That's this role. You'll report to our Head of Product and work as the sole designer, an early design hire, alongside our engineers. You'll be the most senior product design hire we've made, with real influence over what gets built and over how this company thinks about the people it builds for.
If you think understanding people is the hardest and most important part of design, and that everything else follows from that, this is the role for you.
What we care about, in order
01. Human behaviour first
You think in motivation, habit and friction before you think in screens. You understand why people do what they do, and you use that to make product decisions, not just design decisions.
02. Craft and execution
You ship. You work directly with engineers and move fast without losing the quality that makes a product feel premium.
03. AI-native workflows
You understand how modern engineers build with AI tools, and you think about design in that context. We care about principles, components and systems that plug into engineering workflows rather than sitting in static documentation. You're comfortable working close to implementation, and you help keep experiences coherent while teams move quickly with AI-assisted development.
What you'll be working on
Fyxer is an AI-powered productivity platform. You'll design interfaces where the AI does real work: raising something people missed, live transcription, deeply personalised drafts, complex cross-surface workflows. They need to feel effortless despite genuine complexity underneath.
A large part of this role is interaction design. We're building products with real complexity under the hood, and we care about making those experiences feel calm, intuitive and coherent across every touchpoint, such as:
A dashboard experience that makes AI feel like a natural daily habit
A real-time notetaker that generates live transcripts and captures the right context
Personalised AI draft generation that adapts to each user's communication style

You have 5+ years designing in high-growth, early-stage environments where structure was something you built, not something you inherited.
You understand technical constraints well enough to have a real conversation with an engineer, not just hand over a Figma file.
You run your own user research. You talk to users, watch session recordings, and use what you find to defend or change your design decisions.
You move fast and use AI tools to help you. You know when to be rigorous and when to unblock someone with an MVP.

Founding Product Designer
At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.
This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.
Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.
The Basics
Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)
Reports to: founders, working day to day alongside our CTO
The role: our first dedicated designer, owning the product experience end to end

You'd be the first designer at Adclear. Today, design here is developer-led and largely AI/vibe-coded, with no single owner. That's the gap you're filling: the product's look, feel and flow are yours to mold, and the design function is yours to build from the ground up.
This role has two distinct halves, and we're looking for someone who can genuinely do both.
The first is improving what already exists. Adclear is a live product used regularly by enterprises and other customers. You'll bring coherence to the UI, refine and properly apply our existing design system across the app, improve existing functionality, and design complex new features on top of it. Strong UX judgment matters as much as UI polish here: a lot of this is making genuinely complex, regulated workflows navigable for non-technical users like compliance reviewers and marketers.
The second is zero-to-one. We'll likely be building two new product lines from scratch alongside the core product, which means heavy discovery, lots of proof-of-concepts, and rapid iteration through quick mockups, AI-assisted prototypes and user testing. You'll be speaking with customers regularly across both workstreams, not just the new ones.
You won't be handed tidy specs and asked to make them pretty. You'll sit in the messy middle: talking to compliance teams and marketers at banks and fintechs, working out what they actually need, and turning genuinely hard, ambiguous problems into a product that feels obvious once it exists.
This is a design role with a real product management edge. You'll work in tandem with our CTO to shape what we build and why, not just how it looks. You'll help set priorities, scope releases and make the calls that move the roadmap.

Own the end-to-end product experience: from problem definition and research through to interaction design, high-fidelity UI and shipped product
Bring consistency to the existing product: refine and coherently apply our design system across the app, and raise the UX and UI bar on what's already live
Work directly with our CTO to shape the roadmap, scope releases and decide what's worth building, wearing a product manager hat alongside your design one
Lead discovery and build proof-of-concepts for new product lines, moving from sketch to something real fast rather than over weeks
Run your own research: get on customer calls across both the existing product and new lines, sit in on compliance reviews, and turn what you hear into clear product direction
Establish the foundations of design at Adclear: the design system, the patterns, the craft bar and the way design works with engineering and go-to-market
Set up design process from scratch, and help build the design team over time, with the potential to lead it
Partner with engineering from design through implementation, staying close as things get built so the shipped product matches the intent
What you should have
A track record that spans early-stage chaos and later-stage scaling: you joined a company at pre-seed or seed and helped take it through to Series B, or joined at Series A and scaled it through to Series C or D. You may have covered these stages across different companies rather than one.
Genuine range: you're comfortable being dropped into zero-to-one ambiguity, but you've also proven you can take a product to its next level, not only start things from a blank page.
You've shipped code, understand how systems work under the hood, and don't need engineering to explain why something is hard
Prototypes in code as a default, not a last resort - You are a Figma expert and Cursor, Claude Code, or similar are already part of how you work
High agency: comfortable operating as the sole designer under pressure, managing a heavy and varied workload, moving quickly without sacrificing quality
What we hope you have
Exposure to fintech, regtech or another regulated space. A real plus, but not a must.
Experience designing for non-technical operators. You've built for people who use software to get a job done, like compliance reviewers and marketers, not power users who live in the tool.
Fluency moving between fidelities fast. Napkin sketch to clickable prototype in a day, because the fastest way to settle a debate is to make the thing real.
Experience building or leading a design function, or a clear point of view on how you'd start building one here.
How we work
Founders and the CTO are closely involved in the day-to-day, and design has a real seat at the table
Design drives product direction here; it doesn't decorate decisions made elsewhere
The pace is fast and the approach is still being built, and you're one of the people building it
This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula and a full team handed to you on day one

This is a hands-on Staff IC role reporting to the Head of Design, with a strong focus on systems thinking, craft, and execution.

Shape the next generation of Fonoa. Design new AI-powered products and experiences that become core parts of our Tax Operating System.
Own products end to end. Lead the design process from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, prototyping, and launch.
Simplify complexity. Turn sophisticated tax, regulatory, and AI workflows into intuitive experiences that customers trust.
Think in systems. Design scalable foundations, contribute to our new design system, and create patterns that enable future products.
Partner across disciplines. Work closely with Product, Engineering, AI, Tax, and User Research to shape product direction, not just execute requirements.
Raise the quality bar. Champion exceptional craft, attention to detail, and thoughtful execution across everything we build.

Exceptional product craft. You care deeply about interaction design, visual quality, motion, and the details that make products feel effortless.
Strong systems thinking. You can design both individual experiences and the larger product architecture behind them.

UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale.

From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.
We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.
Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.
Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.
Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.
Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.
Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.
Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.
Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.

s.h: Here is a good summary of what we are looking for
s.t:
Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.
Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.
Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.
Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.
Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.
Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.
Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.
Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.
Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.
Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.
Experience with interactive prototyping.
Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

s.h: Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice
s.t:
Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective
Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year
Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment
Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few
Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year
Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership
Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.
Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

Senior Product Designer, Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Experience
Autonomous vehicles are reshaping how people and goods move through cities. At Uber, we're building the experiences that make autonomous mobility feel intuitive, trustworthy, and seamlessly integrated into everyday life.
As a Product Designer on the Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Experience team, you'll define the future of how riders discover, understand, request, and complete autonomous trips. You'll work across the end-to-end journey, turning emerging technology into experiences that millions of people can confidently use.
This is a 0-to-1 environment where you must make big decisions without perfect information and own the outcomes. You'll need to navigate high-stakes ambiguity, balance near-term execution with long-term vision, and advocate for the user in a high-speed, technical landscape. If you think critically and are motivated by the challenge of real-world impact at a global scale, this is where you will grow.

Design end-to-end experiences across the autonomous rider journey, from discovery and booking through pickup, ride, support, and beyond.
Shape product strategy alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, Research, Data Science, and partner teams.
Translate complex technical capabilities and operational constraints into simple, intuitive customer experiences.
Build trust by designing experiences that help riders understand what autonomous vehicles are doing, what to expect, and how to interact with them.
Develop scalable interaction patterns and frameworks that can support multiple autonomous vehicle partners and future capabilities.
Prototype and communicate ideas quickly to drive alignment and accelerate decision making.
Use research, experimentation, and data to continuously improve the rider experience.
Raise the quality bar through systems thinking, strong craft, and thoughtful design execution.

5+ years of professional product design experience, with a proven track record of shipping, scaling, and iterating on high-quality consumer products.
A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking alongside exceptional design craft.
Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
Demonstrated proficiency with AI-first design workflows, alongside exceptional interaction design, visual design, and prototyping skills.
Strong communication and storytelling skills with cross-functional partners and leadership and experience influencing product strategy beyond individual features.

Experience with transportation, mapping, mobility, logistics, robotics, or AI-powered products.
Experience building and implementing components within a global, scalable design system.
Experience designing physical-digital experiences, including automotive HMI, in-vehicle experiences, or other connected products.
Proven ability to collaborate with user researchers and data scientists to drive experimentation and A/B testing.
Deep expertise in AI-native design workflows and complex technical prototyping, including building custom tools, agents, and production-ready implementations.

Autonomous mobility represents one of the biggest shifts in transportation in decades. You'll have the opportunity to define experiences that don't yet have industry standards, influence how millions of people interact with autonomous technology, and help shape the future of mobility on a global scale.
